runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Mapo Tofu, French Onion Soup Gratinée, Baked Vacherin Mont d'Or
runs.content:
1. Mapo Tofu with Pork and Sichuan Peppercorn, inspired by David Chang. A 30-minute numbing-hot weeknight bowl of soft tofu and crisp pork in chilli bean sauce over rice.
2. Soupe à l'Oignon Gratinée (Les Halles French Onion Soup), inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The technique dish: a kilo of onions caramelised to mahogany, dark stock, and a blistered Gruyère lid.
3. Baked Vacherin Mont d'Or with New Potatoes, Cornichons and Ham, inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: a seasonal winter cheese baked molten in its box with garlic, thyme and white wine.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Kimchi Jjigae, Chicken Leek and Tarragon Pie, Pork Sisig
runs.content:
1. Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi, Pork and Tofu Stew), inspired by David Chang. A 35-minute fiery, sour Korean one-pot built on extra-fermented kimchi fried in pork fat.
2. Chicken, Leek and Tarragon Pie, inspired by Nigel Slater. A poached-chicken, leek and cream pie under an all-butter puff lid, using leeks at their November best.
3. Pork Sisig with Calamansi and Chilli, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: Pampanga-style simmered, grilled and chopped pork belly served sizzling with an egg and cold beer.
